description: This file is a code-behind for an ASP.NET Web Forms page that allows administrators or users to edit theory courses. It handles UI interactions such as page loading, course selection, semester selection, navigation buttons, and session management.

classes.name: OnlineExamSystem.EditTheory
classes.description: Partial class for handling server-side logic of the EditTheory.aspx page in the OnlineExamSystem.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial page load event.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Admin Panel page when the home button is clicked.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Admin Queue page when the profile button is clicked.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Transfers to the Admin Leaderboard page when the leaderboard button is clicked.

methods.name: searchB_Click
methods.description: Sets session variable '_CRS' with selected course text.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by transferring to the login page.

methods.name: selectB_Click
methods.description: Populates the course dropdown based on the selected semester.

methods.name: selectSemesterDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Updates course dropdown when semester selection changes.

methods.name: SelectCourseDropDownList_SelectedIndexChanged
methods.description: Placeholder for handling course selection changes, currently empty.
